# clavis syncs run

<p class="cli-lead">Preview or execute a sync</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis syncs run ID [flags]
```

</div>

Run a sync now. `--dry-run` previews the keys that would change; `--yes` skips the confirmation.

## Examples

```sh
clavis syncs run 123e4567 --dry-run
clavis syncs run 123e4567 --yes
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-dry-run"><dt><code>--dry-run</code></dt><dd>preview without sending values</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-yes"><dt><code>--yes</code></dt><dd>confirm and execute the sync</dd></div>
</dl>
